name: Memory Vault
runtime_test_scope: Four synthetic real-HTTP workflows passed using extracted alpha.0.14 runtime and child nodes: mailbox provision/register; ACK-bearing interrupted admission and cold proof recovery; cold selected-memory import with receipt return, lost-reply restart and owner recovery; independent Agent ACK preparation/export with the original delivery node offline. The published alpha.0.14 exact-source full cloud regression failed two cases; follow-up fix commit fed27ad passed full regression. Candidate alpha.0.15 full regression failed fixture setup/service-start cases and remains unpublished. Later fixes passed the affected 21 local workflows; Alpha.0.16 passed thirteen extracted-runtime workflows but its full run recorded an expired-handle fixture error and hit the CI wall limit. Alpha.0.17 passed fourteen extracted-runtime workflows and supported Python 3.10; its full run was cancelled after confirming the same test defect. Both remain unpublished. Alpha.0.18 completed 1,059 tests with one ACK-bearing mailbox custody failure and remains unpublished. A slowed local child download reproduced handle expiry; alpha.0.19 funds and performs bounded possession renewals in the exhaustive fixture and requires its own acceptance. No external adoption, global reliability or thousand-agent capacity claim.
